title: Victim chat 7 — wallet recovery claim
desc: Victim claims to have lost access to Trust Wallet

messages.text: Hi, I am Trust Wallet Support. How can I help you?
I cannot access my wallet. I need to recover 2.3 ETH.
messages.translation: I cannot access my wallet. I need to recover 2.3 ETH.

messages.text: We need a deposit of 0.1 ETH to verify your identity and begin recovery.

title: Victim chat 92 — OFAC compliance block
desc: Victim account flagged under OFAC screening

messages.text: Your account has been flagged under OFAC compliance review. You must submit a replacement verification fee.
What does OFAC mean? I have never done anything wrong.
messages.translation: What does OFAC mean? I have never done anything wrong.

messages.text: Please comply or your funds will remain frozen.

title: Victim chat 446 — general support inquiry
desc: Victim asking about swap fees, no fraud keywords

messages.text: Hello, I have a question about swap fees.
